name: QWEN-LOOP-STATE-0
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-LOOP-STATE-0 (RESULTS L36233, committed b02c5df pre-launch). Restructured post-run to pass llmopt.lab.prereg.validate: capture/preconditions moved verbatim to qwen-loop-state-0.params.json; bar THRESHOLDS (0.99 / 0.80 / 0.05) and conjunctive semantics unchanged, but the bar contract STRINGS were edited to bind observation keys — bars[0].metric renamed min_over_items_median_cosine_homologous -> min_over_items_median_cosine; bars[1] split from compound metric/direction/value ('top1_agreement_frac AND median_js_nats', 'above; below', [0.8,0.05]) into a scalar bar plus a conjuncts block. The authoritative registration is the RESULTS text at b02c5df.

BLe.description: BLe on qcuda-tower, xhigh cell, greedy observation-only regen of items 0/4 (primary exact orbits) + 3 (semantic-restart contrast), sparse fp32 pre-head h capture at frozen positions

bars.name: INTERNAL-ORBIT
bars.aggregation: median per item, min over items
bars.description: median cosine(h_p, h_{p+kL}) >= 0.99 in BOTH items 0 and 4

bars.name: STUCK-RETRY-POLICY
bars.description: top1 identical fraction >= 0.80 AND median full-vocab JS (fp64, natural log) <= 0.05 nats

refuted_if: bar 1 median cosine < 0.90 on EITHER item 0 or 4: tokens recur without internal-state recurrence, killing the internal-attractor reading
registered_prior: bar 1 FIRES with medians > 0.999 on both items; bar 2 FIRES on both clauses
